task.title: Share workflow-phase task preflight without changing authority
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/759 by replacing repeated authority-sensitive preflight logic with one private helper while preserving every public behavior and error boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Centralize active task association, evidence identity and lineage, writable session, and phase-skill validation.
Keep observation kind and optional parent Attempt explicit at each caller.
Preserve validation order, errors, side effects, persistence, and public APIs.
Pass existing workflow-phase behavior tests unchanged.

attempts.summary: Confirmed the duplication and behavior constraints.
attempts.diagnostic: Review of the failure slice identified four synchronized copies of the same task, evidence, session, and skill preflight.
attempts.patch: Opened a bounded refactor issue rather than widening the reviewed feature change.

attempts.diagnostic: The common sequence varied only by explicit observation kind and optional parent Attempt lineage.
attempts.patch: Added a private helper returning the validated session and selected skills, then routed Attempt and Correction callers through it.

attempts.summary: Held a false-green review status until substantive capacity returned.
attempts.diagnostic: The Rust quality gate passed, but CodeRabbit reported review limiting and initially produced no substantive review.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge disarmed, waited through the cooldown, and resumed review only after a fresh budget check.

outcome.summary: Workflow-phase task operations now share one fail-closed preflight implementation while retaining explicit evidence lineage, deterministic errors, and unchanged authority boundaries.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_runtime

lessons: Authority-sensitive validation order should have one implementation once repetition becomes real.
Generic mechanics can be shared while semantic kind and lineage remain explicit at call sites.
An unchanged behavior suite is strong refactor evidence when the tests cover side-effect ordering.
A green rate-limited status cannot establish substantive review.
